1: The door back out to Warrior City.
S: Shelves of everything: rope, rations, a hat with a feather, one boot.
u: The counter. A bell on it says RING FOR SERVICE. It has been rung a great deal.
k: A crate stamped WARRIOR CITY: HANDLE WITH STRENGTH.

objects.name: Shopkeeper Dunstan
lines: Welcome! Everything you need, mostly. Everything you don't need, definitely.

answer: Rope. Lanterns. A bridge-crossing permit, though the bridge is shut.
Everybody wants a hat. They just don't know it yet.
You'd suit a big one. Covers more of the face.
